$comment: Share images and social posts, from the agd-playground posts tool (src/components/conare-og: draw.ts, layouts.ts, brand.ts, content.ts, app.ts; route /conare and its PNG endpoint /conare/og). The layout rules are the engine's (src/assets/og.ts, ported from draw.ts); this file holds the brand's part: themes as token names (an alpha after a slash), the frame tones, highlight colors, the footer line, the art files, the agent panel's colors and sample copy, each template's opening theme and copy, and the sizes. Every playground hex matched a token except the ones in notes.

panel.$comment: The dark agent window (app.ts), drawn on a 1040 by 640 grid. Sample copy replaces the playground's third-party product names (Granola, Salesforce, Gmail, Attio) and the Northwind account with neutral ones.

notes: Every playground brand color (brand.ts INK) is a token: white off-white, black off-black, red home-red, paper home-paper, grey home-grey, n100 to n700 neutral-100 to neutral-700.

Agent panel: the playground's #1f1e1d ground is neutral-100 (#201F1E); its rules #3a3937 and chips #2c2b2a have no token and draw in neutral-200 (#31302F); the field chip edge #4a4846 is neutral-300 (#494745).
Product window ground: the playground's #ffffff is off-white (#FEFEFE); the empty window's #f4f2f7 is home-paper.

The card's chip and the footer use Geist Mono at 500 in the playground; the brand ships Geist Mono 400 only, so they draw at 400. The partner name draws at 600 in Faculty Glyphic, which ships at 400 only.

Left out: the playground's product scenes (public/conare-og/screens/*.jpg) show third-party logos (Granola, Salesforce, Gmail, Attio) and photos of people. The feature window takes your picture with --image; without one it draws a stand-in scene from the brand's own parts (the room, the stacks and the agent panel).

Left out: partner logos (third-party art; pass the partner's name), the editor's free stickers and gradients (not templates), and random layout seeds (in the playground a seed only picks one of these templates).
